observation: decorating an existing file requires intents for EVERY export — incremental adoption needs per-file intent planning before the first decoration write

a multi-concern authoring request can silently narrow at Stage 4 — the confirm list must be re-read against the original request (sync intents dropped from the role-vocabulary dialog; re-authored in a scoped dialog)
dusk init writes the gate hook command assuming a package-local @dusk/pre-tool-use install; in a workspace the path must point at the workspace binary
a null-aspect @intent-test-file claim mapped to an empty cover set, so a test-body pre-pass rejection vanished — fixed in @dusk/runtime-test-runner with a regression test
commit_summary: fix(test-runner): null-aspect test-file claims cover all intent triples
